name: Double-crowding fade — high funding x rich basis confirm crowded longs (perp short)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (funding_rate x perp_spot_basis), SHORT — the two-gauge crowding confirmation on the SHORT side. funding-contrarian-crash-filter fades positive-funding crowded longs using funding ALONE. This requires a SECOND orthogonal confirmation: a RICH (positive) perp_spot_basis says the perp is also trading at a premium to spot (longs over-paying on the term structure too). When BOTH the realized funding payment AND the term-structure basis are stretched rich simultaneously, the crowded-long state is double-confirmed and the eventual unwind/cascade is more reliable than either gauge alone — a meta-labeling-by-confirmation short. Mechanism before data: short when funding is above a fitted crowding ceiling AND perp_spot_basis is above a fitted premium ceiling AND price has stopped making new highs (a short ret roll-over guard so we short exhaustion, not a melt-up); stop ABOVE, take-profit BELOW; exit when funding normalizes down. Distinct from funding-contrarian-crash-filter (funding only), perp-basis-premium-contrarian-short (basis only + momentum), and g2-greed-distribution-top-fade-short (survey greed, not derivatives crowding). Disconfirmer 1: drop the basis arm — if funding-only shorting matches the deflated Sharpe, basis adds nothing (it duplicates the existing funding short). Disconfirmer 2: drop funding — if basis-only matches, it duplicates the basis-premium short. The edge must require BOTH gauges rich. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): perp short pays/earns funding (funding_feature set); net of ~20bps+. tier0 funding_rate + tier0 perp_spot_basis, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS; SHORT = perp.
catalyst: perp funding rich AND perp_spot_basis rich simultaneously (double-confirmed crowded longs) with price rolling over — faded with a perp short
